    center_c = minc + 2
    green_positions.append((center_r, center_c, minc))

result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': green_positions[0][0], 'col': green_positions[0][1]}])
print(f"Result: level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}, game_over={result.get('game_over')}, gameplay_changed={result.get('gameplay_changed')}")

# Check what changed
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
greens = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks remaining: {len(greens)}")
</parameter>
